manager_persona: Engineering Manager — AI Platform. After exercise 01 they got their traces. Now they want survivability. Has lived through (a) a worker restart that vanished 47 active conversations and produced an angry customer-success thread, (b) an Anthropic regional outage that took the agent down for 2 hours because no fallback was wired. Cardinal sins: (a) state lost on restart, (b) primary 429 propagating as 5xx to the user, (c) unbounded conversation that crashes context window, (d) a 'fallback' that's actually just a retry on the same model. Voice: tactical, references real incidents, asks for trace evidence on every fallback claim.

expected.instructions: /health returns 200. modules_active includes both 'observability' AND 'state-fallback'. Score 10 if both modules listed. Score 0 if state-fallback missing (means agent didn't even claim to implement this exercise).

Multi-step probe. (1) POST /chat conv_id=conv_dur turn 1: 'Hi I am on Pro+'. (2) POST /chat conv_id=conv_dur turn 2: 'Whats the refund window for me?'. (3) Force a worker restart (the LMS judge sends an admin signal or briefly cycles the container; for this graded probe we simulate via a 30s gap and a separate health check). (4) After restart, POST /chat conv_id=conv_dur turn 3: 'I bought 21 days ago. Can I refund?'. The turn 3 reply MUST reference Pro+ context from turn 1 AND apply the Pro+ refund window from turn 2. ALSO call GET /state/conv_dur — turn_count >= 3, messages array contains all turns. Score 10 if context preserved AND state endpoint returns full history. Score 5 if state endpoint shows history but turn 3 reply ignores prior context. Score 0 if state was lost (CARDINAL SIN).

Fire 25 turns on conv_long with mixed content. Turn 3 explicitly says 'My name is Sam and I run a small SaaS called Bracket'. Turns 4-24 are general questions. Turn 25 asks 'What was my company name again?'. The agent should answer 'Bracket' or reference it. ALSO inspect any of turns 11-25's response: summary_compression_applied SHOULD be true on at least one turn. Inspect a trace from turn 15+: a 'summarise' span MUST exist with output.summary populated. Score 10 if turn 25 recalls 'Bracket' AND summarise span present. Score 5 if turn 25 fails recall but summary span exists (means the summary didn't capture the right info). Score 0 if the agent crashes with context-length 4xx anywhere in the 25 turns OR if no summarise span exists by turn 25.

input.message: What does the Analytics addon include?

expected.instructions: Fire /chat with header X-Test-Force-Primary-429: 1. The response MUST: (a) status 200 (not 5xx), (b) fallback_chain_taken: true, (c) fallback_reason includes '429' or 'primary', (d) model_used is NOT the primary model name. Then fetch the trace: MUST contain attempt_primary span with error indication, AND attempt_secondary span that succeeded. Score 10 if all conditions. Score 5 if status 200 but fallback_chain_taken: false (means fallback didn't fire). Score 0 if status >= 500 (CARDINAL SIN: 429 propagated as 5xx).

input.message: Tell me about Pro vs Pro+ plans

expected.instructions: Fire /chat with header X-Test-Force-Primary-Timeout: 1. Same checks as primary-429 but fallback_reason should reference 'timeout'. The total request latency must be bounded (≤ 12s including the timeout). Score 10 if fallback fired AND total_latency ≤ 12s. Score 5 if fallback fired but latency > 12s. Score 0 if status >= 500 OR fallback didn't fire.

Fire /chat with header X-Test-Force-All-Fail: 1. Expected: HTTP status 503 (NOT 500). Body MUST include: degraded: true, fallback_chain_taken: true, fallback_reason: 'all_tiers_failed' (or similar), reply (a polite human-routing message), trace_id (tracing didn't disappear). Score 10 if all conditions. Score 6 if status 503 but missing degraded/reason fields. Score 3 if status 200 with template reply (acceptable but not the explicit-degraded signal). Score 0 if status 500 (panic, not graceful).

Fire /chat with header X-Test-Slow-Kb-Ms: 6000. The agent's tool-call timeout (default 5s) should trip. Total request latency MUST be ≤ 8s (5s tool timeout + ~3s LLM). Trace MUST show retrieve_kb span with error containing 'timeout' OR duration_ms ≈ 5000±500. Reply must NOT fabricate a refund-policy answer (since retrieval failed) — should either ask for clarification OR explicitly note it can't pull docs right now. Score 10 if all conditions. Score 5 if timeout enforced but reply fabricates. Score 0 if request hangs > 10s.

input.message: Tell me about the Pro plan in 3 sentences

expected.instructions: Fire /chat with body field stream:true. Expected Content-Type: text/event-stream. The response should produce ≥2 SSE 'data:' chunks before a final chunk with done:true (or equivalent). The grader counts chunks. Score 10 if ≥2 chunks AND final chunk has trace_id + totals. Score 6 if exactly 1 chunk (means the service buffered — minor issue but functional). Score 0 if no SSE at all (Content-Type wrong) or hangs.

input.message: What does the Analytics addon include?

expected.instructions: Fire /chat with X-Test-Force-Primary-429: 1, capture trace_id, fetch the trace. MUST include: (a) attempt_primary span (showing error/429), (b) attempt_secondary span (the success), (c) all the standard observability axes from exercise 01 (tokens, cost, latency, model). Score 10 if all spans present. Score 5 if traces exist but missing one of the attempt spans. Score 0 if fallback execution isn't traced at all (regression on observability).

Fire 4 /chat turns on conv_state. Then GET /state/conv_state. Response MUST contain: messages (array of length 8 = 4 user + 4 assistant), turn_count >= 4, conversation_id matching, last_updated_at recent. Score 10 if all fields. Score 5 if endpoint returns valid JSON but missing fields. Score 0 if endpoint returns 404 (means no introspection — durability cannot be tested).

input.message: What addons can I add to Pro?

expected.instructions: Fire /chat with X-Test-Force-Primary-429:1 and check cost_usd in response. Expected: cost_usd ≤ $0.06 (allows for primary attempt + secondary, both counted). The trace's primary attempt span will likely show 0 tokens (since it was forced 429); the secondary's tokens count toward the bill. Compare to a non-forced /chat — fallback cost should be at most 1.5× the normal cost. Score 10 if cost_usd ≤ $0.06. Score 5 if ≤ $0.10. Score 0 if > $0.15 (fallback chain is wasting money).

input.message: Whats included in the Pro plan and addons

expected.instructions: Fire a normal /chat (no test headers). Verify: trace_id present, citations array populated with verbatim quotes, tokens/cost reported, latency reported. This re-checks that exercise 01's observability axes still pass after the state+fallback rework. Score 10 if all 01 invariants hold. Score 5 if minor regressions (e.g., cost variance suspiciously low). Score 0 if trace_id absent OR citations broken (means the rework regressed on 01).

Fetch /eval. Should now have ≥18 entries (learners are expected to extend beyond the demo's 12). Tags should include happy_path, must_escalate, edge_case at minimum. avg_score in [0.5, 0.95]. Score 10 if ≥18 entries with required tags. Score 5 if 12-17. Score 0 if endpoint absent.
